Subject: Welcome — Cerulean vendor invite (Coupa)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick turnaround here. Our procurement team pushed the Coupa invite to the vendor contact for Redwood and we're seeing the invite land, but the user hits an SSO error when they try to accept — the portal reports 'Session fragment not recognized' and then drops them back to our IdP. From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Cc: sophiE.grant@ceruleanbio.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Welcome — Cerulean vendor invite (Coupa)

Forwarding — Cerulean's invite is hitting an SSO handoff/session fragmentation error during Coupa accept. Screenshot attached (they captured the IdP redirect loop).

Notes: our vendor onboarding uses an SP-initiated SAML flow with a persistent NameID by default. We normally accept transient NameIDs if the RelayState contains the vendor tenant id, but this looks like a RelayState -> Recipient mismatch (Cerulean's IdP sending back a URL with an extra path segment).

Can infra/auth take a quick look at the SAML logs and see whether the assertion Recipient matches the ACS URL we published? If a short-term manual activation is feasible, please include the CSV we can upload to Coupa.

Thanks — Rafael
Director, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Included original message below.

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Welcome — Cerulean vendor invite (Coupa)

Quick triage notes — I reproduced locally using a test Cerulean account and saw the same redirect chain. Steps I ran:
- Started SP-initiated flow from Coupa test page
- IdP returns Assertion with Recipient = https://coupa.ceruleanbio.com/sso/accept (missing the /vendor/tenant segment)
- Our ACS expects https://coupa.ceruleanbio.com/vendor/tenant/accept so the Recipient check fails and the session clears

Short-term workaround: manual activation via Coupa CSV import. I've sketched the fields required and attached a stub activation-csv.csv — Marissa, can ops upload this to their tenant and set the initial account "Active" flag?

Longer term: ask Cerulean IdP to include the full ACS/Recipient or we relax the strict Recipient check for this tenant while we validate SAML metadata. Rafael, if you want I can draft the exact IdP metadata snippet they should add.

- Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation-csv.csv (vendor activation stub)
